source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique common TBD identity; OOB variant and audited 0x44 method supply related mechanics, not Master content.

source_snapshot.procedure: During Test TBD; generic pre-step clears logs.

historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Audited OOB variant establishes standard App 0x06/0x44 and finite channel/User-ID policy matrix.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Historical classification is REQUIRES PACKAGE; ED-34 makes matrix/policy Project inputs rather than permanent block.

original_test_intent: Read access/count/privilege state for an approved channel and finite user-ID matrix, then compare decoded non-secret fields with the Project security policy.
original_method: Use Project-selected protected transport and standard read-only App 0x06/0x44, with bounded signed matrix, errata-aware parser, redaction and no setters.
manual_activity: Security owner supplies the finite channel/User-ID matrix, governing channel policy and exceptions; collection/decoding is automated by the approved package.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Appropriately refuses naked TBD, but historical audited evidence defines a safe standard read once Project scope/package exists.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Protected App 0x06/0x44 for each signed channel/User-ID pair with exact completion/length/field validation.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run an approved finite matrix, decode maximum/enabled/fixed counts and per-user access/privilege under firmware errata, compare with channel policy and redact identities.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds standards-based Review guidance without modifying TBD Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Only approved pairs/transport are covered; no user write or automatic enumeration.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Security-sensitive output and errata differences can misstate enabled or effective privilege.

project_override_considerations: IB/OOB/vendor wrappers are allowed when they expose equivalent 0x44 fields; record chosen transport and do not claim unqueried accounts.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master title identifies a standard read but Procedure/Criteria are TBD and clear security logs; the Review layer must supply method/scope while preserving that source gap.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Historical audited 0x44 mechanics resolve core operation semantics; matrix, transport and expected policy are Project readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Avoids permanently blocking a defined read while bounding account enumeration and preserving sensitive-field/errata controls.
independent_technical_reasoning: Get User Access is a standard non-mutating read, so lack of Project matrix or policy is not a permanent semantic block. Because a finite matrix, parser and security reference are mandatory, REQUIRES PACKAGE is more accurate than FULLY or BLOCKED.
